title: Inconsistent API reference format requirements across CLI commands
description: Different CLI commands accept different API reference formats, causing confusion and errors. Some commands accept 'vendor/name' while others require 'vendor/name/version', but this is not clearly indicated in error messages or help text.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to use the same format with a command expecting 'vendor/name/version' (fails with error)
expected_behavior: CLI commands should either accept a consistent API reference format across all commands, or provide clear guidance in help text and error messages about which format is expected.
actual_behavior: Commands accept different formats without clear documentation, and error messages only indicate the expected format after the user has already made an error.
evidence: error: invalid API reference "jentic-test/test-api"; expected vendor/name/version
